description: List VerusIDs in the local wallet. Returns all identities that this wallet can spend for, sign for, or watch. Use this to discover which identities are available before performing identity operations. By default includes identities we can spend for and sign for, but not watch-only.

includecansign.description: Include identities we can only sign for but not spend. Default: true.

includecanspend.description: Include identities we can spend/authorize for. Default: true.

includewatchonly.description: Include identities we can neither sign nor spend, but are watched or are co-signers. Default: false.

name: listidentities
